name: Eagan (United States)
description: White field charged with the city logo, a green tree over green lines above the name EAGAN in green.
history: Eagan is a city in Dakota County, Minnesota. The flag was adopted on 3 October 2017 (unveiled with the new city logo on 3 October 2017, according to Flags of the World citing the city website).

features.role: green tree of the city logo
